description: This file implements a localization bundle for the Mattermost plugin system, providing functions to load localization files, retrieve localizers for users and server defaults, and localize messages with error handling.

classes.name: Bundle
classes.description: A struct that embeds i18n.Bundle and manages localization message files and localizers.

methods.name: InitBundle
methods.description: Initializes a Bundle by loading localization JSON files from a specified directory, excluding 'active.en.json'.

methods.name: GetUserLocalizer
methods.description: Returns a localizer for a specific user based on their locale, with fallback to server locale on error.

methods.name: GetServerLocalizer
methods.description: Returns a localizer for the default server locale.

methods.name: LocalizeDefaultMessage
methods.description: Localizes a message using a provided localizer, returning an empty string on failure.

methods.name: LocalizeWithConfig
methods.description: Localizes a message with a given localization configuration, returning an empty string on failure.
